comment.narrative: The Women Elected Officials Network plays a proactive role in a womens movement advocating for increased representation of women. In response to these efforts the High National Elections Commission demonstrated responsiveness by issuing a decree that raises the quota for womens representation in municipal councils to 2 out of 9 councillors and 3 out of 11 councillors. The WEON is still making advocacy efforts to raise the quota in the local and natinal councils The Women Empoerment Unit of the ministry of Local Government is impelenting women empowerment units in all the municipalities.

In response to these efforts the High National Elections Commission demonstrated responsiveness by issuing a decree that raises the quota for womens representation in municipal councils to 2 out of 9 councillors and 3 out of 11 councillors. The WEON is still making advocacy efforts to raise the quota in the local and natinal councils The Women Empoerment Unit of the ministry of Local Government is impelenting women empowerment units in all the municipalities.
